method: Native values verified against LIVE human-readable source pages where a trade-value page exists. FantasyPros, USA Today, CBS scraped directly from article pages. FantasyCalc via the API powering its human-visible page (same numbers). ESPN, CBS ROS, and Razzball have no published trade value chart; their projection-derived values are traced but live trade-value verification is unavailable.

espn.source_note: ESPN Fantasy Football player projections page (human-readable). Mike Clay ROS projections scraped LIVE from this page.

cbs.source_note: CBS Sports Dave Richards Week 4 trade chart article. Values scraped LIVE from this page.

cbsros.source_note: CBS Sports rest-of-season projections (per position; nonppr slug). Not a trade chart -- raw ROS stat projections, computed into value-above-waivers the way the ESPN leg is. No live trade-value to scrape.

razzball.source_note: Razzball rest-of-season projections. Not a trade chart -- published per-game projections, computed into value-above-waivers the way the ESPN leg is. No live trade-value to scrape.

fantasycalc.source_note: FantasyCalc trade value chart (human UI). Settings: Redraft, 12 teams, 0.5 PPR, TEP off, Superflex off. Values scraped LIVE from this page.

fantasypros.source_note: FantasyPros Week 4 trade value chart article. Values scraped LIVE from this page.

usatoday.source_note: USA Today Week 4 trade value chart. Half-PPR column scraped LIVE from this page.

fantasypros_adjusted.source_note: VORP-translated bias-adjusted variant of fantasypros; inherits FantasyPros Week 4 trade value chart article. Values scraped LIVE from this page.

usatoday_adjusted.source_note: VORP-translated bias-adjusted variant of usatoday; inherits USA Today Week 4 trade value chart. Half-PPR column scraped LIVE from this page.

fantasycalc_adjusted.source_note: VORP-translated bias-adjusted variant of fantasycalc; inherits FantasyCalc trade value chart (human UI). Settings: Redraft, 12 teams, 0.5 PPR, TEP off, Superflex off. Values scraped LIVE from this page.

cbs_adjusted.source_note: VORP-translated bias-adjusted variant of cbs; inherits CBS Sports Dave Richards Week 4 trade chart article. Values scraped LIVE from this page.
